content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Maya: morninggg still half asleep
Leo: same, in line for coffee again
Me: need it so bad, my laptop already dragging
Maya: ugh not again, did you restart it?
Me: not yet, just opened everything and prayed lol
Leo: that's the full toolkit right there
Maya: my legs are finally okay from monday btw
Leo: stairs don't hurt anymore?
Maya: a little but way better, might do arms tomorrow
Me: it's freezing out again huh, wore the heavy jacket
Leo: same, fall jacket uniform continues
Maya: need tea after this coffee tbh
Leo: get me the weird lemon one virtually
Me: chamomile for me please
Maya: one weird one for leo, chamomile for you, got it
Leo: she remembers
Me: slow work morning for you guys?
Maya: meetings till 11 then free-ish
Leo: standup in like 10 then nothing
Me: lucky, i'm just staring at emails
Maya: okay so bad news about next friday
Leo: oh no what happened
Me: the pizza thing?
Maya: yeah rosa's is closed, like temporarily closed closed
Leo: whaaat seriously?
Me: nooo i was looking forward to it
Maya: i know, walked by the oak street one and there's a sign on the door
Leo: that sucks
Maya: can we just do mario's on pine instead for next friday?
Leo: yeah that works for me, i know that one
Me: yeah that works, still good for me too
Maya: thank god, i felt bad, we already locked it in
Leo: nah you're good, at least we have a backup
Me: still noon works?
Maya: yeah still noon works for me
Leo: yep noon still works
Me: perfect, i can still walk over
Maya: i can still bus easy, pine is fine
Leo: parking sucked there last time but whatever, i'll circle
Me: lol you circled forever last time
Maya: as long as no salty olive bomb this time
Leo: exactly, skip olives forever
Me: crust was perfect otherwise tho
Maya: garlic knots i'm coming for you pt 2
Leo: crying suit guy would approve
Me: never go back to workkkk
Maya: HAHAHA stop, still stuck in my head
Leo: my kitchen is a mess again btw
Me: nooo you cleared the sink thing!
Maya: reboot already?
Leo: rude but accurate, lasted like four days",
  "writer_note": "Kept it in a morning window with coffee/work chatter, then had Maya deliver the Rosa's closure and propose Mario's, with both others giving clear short acceptances while confirming noon and the trio stay the same without reciting the full plan."
}
